notes.title: Fixed an issue about achievement
notes.content: Fixed an issue where achievement did not work properly.

notes.title: New languages added!
notes.content:
The following seven languages have been added to Unreal Life:


 Chinese (Simplified)
 Chinese (Traditional)
 Korean
 French
 German
 Italian
 Spanish


We hope that even more people throughout the world will be able to enjoy Unreal Life's story!
